title: Your WhatsApp agent now handles the sale end to end, payment included.
summary: Cashfree is now a connected app on Meta Business Agent. Your WhatsApp agent can answer, recommend and collect payment in the same chat, while you get on with running your business.
body_markdown:
Table of Contents


Toggle


For millions of small businesses in India, WhatsApp is the shop counter. Customers browse your catalogue, ask about sizes and delivery, bargain a little, and decide to buy. All of it happens in a chat.


The conversation part of selling is getting help fast. More than one million businesses already use[Meta Business Agent](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/06/meta-business-agent/) on WhatsApp and Messenger to reply to customers around the clock. But for most of them, the money part still waits for a person: sharing a payment link or QR code, checking that the money came in, and following up to confirm the order.


That’s the gap we’re closing. Cashfree is now a connected app on Meta Business Agent. Once you connect it, your agent requests a Cashfree Payment Link the moment a customer says “I’ll take it”, shares it right in the chat, and Cashfree collects the payment securely on your behalf.


From “Is this available?” to “Payment received”, in one conversation, without you typing a word.


##


**Until now, the last step was manual. That’s where sales slipped.**


Think about what happens after a customer decides to buy on WhatsApp, without an agent. You find your UPI ID or QR code and send it. The customer pays, or says they will. You wait for a screenshot, then match it against your bank messages. Then you message them back to confirm the order.


If you’re busy, they wait. If it’s late, they wait till morning. And while they wait, they cool off, get distracted, or buy from someone who replied faster.


None of these losses look dramatic. There’s no error message, no failed transaction. Just a chat that went quiet after “How much?”. Across a busy week, or a festive season, those quiet chats add up to real revenue.


##


**A new reality for small businesses**


Small businesses have long sold without a website, using payment links and payment forms to collect money. What they couldn’t do was sell around the clock without someone on duty: a person had to answer every question, send every link and check every payment. That’s why always-on selling has mostly belonged to big brands with support teams.


With Meta Business Agent and Cashfree, a two-person business can now do the same from the WhatsApp Business app. A customer who messages at 11 pm gets answers, a payment link and a confirmed order before you’ve even seen the chat.


Your WhatsApp number stops being just a place to talk. It becomes a storefront that sells and collects payments, even when you’re not looking.


##


**Who can benefit most by selling this way**


If your customers ask questions before they buy, and a chat can take them all the way to payment, this is built for you. A few examples:


###


**Beauty, fashion and personal care**


“Is this good for oily skin?” “Is this cotton?” “Will it reach Pune by Friday?” These questions decide a sale, and they come in all day. Your agent answers from your catalogue and product details, suggests the right product, and sends the payment link once the customer picks one. Questions that used to stall in your inbox now end in an order.


###


**Gifting, hampers and made-to-order**


A customer wants 20 Diwali return gifts under ₹600 each, with name tags. Your agent suggests a kit, handles the changes, confirms delivery dates, and collects the full amount, or an advance, before you start packing. Bulk and custom orders, the ones worth the most, no longer wait for you to be free.


###


**Home bakers and food businesses**


Cake orders, festive boxes, weekly tiffin plans. Your agent shares the menu and prices, takes the order details, and collects payment upfront, so you only bake what’s paid for.


###


**Services: salons, tutors, trainers, decorators**


Your agent answers questions about packages and prices, helps book a slot, and collects a booking amount to confirm it. Fewer no-shows, and no awkward follow-ups about the advance.


###


**Boutiques and local stores**


“Send me kurtas under ₹1,500.” Your agent shares options from your catalogue, answers questions about sizes and returns, and collects payment when the customer decides. Your store stays open after the shutters come down.


If you have a very large catalogue, prices that change often, or complex order management, you may need more setup to keep your agent’s product information accurate.


##


**Where this fits**


Buying is moving into conversations. More and more, a customer’s first stop isn’t a website. It’s a chat, and increasingly an AI agent on the other side of it.


We see a sale in a chat happening in three parts:


1. **Conversation:** answer the customer’s questions.
2. **Recommendation:** help them choose.
3. **Payment:** collect payment the moment they decide.


Meta Business Agent handles the first two. Cashfree completes the third. You set up the agent and fulfil the order. It’s part of how we’re building[payments for agent-led commerce](https://www.cashfree.com/agentic-payments/) : wherever an AI agent helps someone decide to buy, Cashfree is the payment layer underneath.


##


**What your customer sees**


1. They message your business on WhatsApp and ask about a product.
2. Your agent answers, suggests options and confirms the details.
3. They say they want to buy.
4. A Cashfree payment request appears in the chat, showing your business name, the amount and a Pay now button.
5. They tap Pay now, pay with their preferred method, and land back in the same chat.


##


**Why this is a revenue channel, not just a convenience**


It’s easy to see an AI agent as a way to save time on replies. The bigger shift is what happens to your sales.


**You capture demand you used to miss.** Enquiries that arrive late at night, on Sundays, or in the middle of a festive rush no longer wait for you. Every one of them now has a path to a paid order.


**You close at the moment of intent.** Every minute between “I’ll take it” and a way to pay is a chance for the customer to change their mind. Your agent removes that gap. The payment request arrives the moment they decide.


**Payments in the chat convert better.** Cashfree’s[WhatsApp Payment Links](https://www.cashfree.com/whatsapp-payment-links/) show up as a clean in-chat widget with your business name, the amount and a Pay now button, instead of a raw URL. On WhatsApp Payment Links, we’ve seen conversion rise to 25% and more, against 3 to 5% for payment links sent over SMS or email.


**You take bigger orders, not just more.** Bulk orders, custom work and advances are where a small business makes its best margins. They’re also the orders that need the most back-and-forth. Now that back-and-forth ends in a payment, not a pending chat.


**You grow without hiring.** Your agent handles routine conversations in parallel, so a busy season doesn’t mean missed chats or an extra salary.


##


**Selling on autopilot, still in your control**


Handing customer chats and payments to an agent only works if you trust it. So the setup keeps you in charge:


- **Payment requests follow the customer’s decision.** Your agent sends a payment request when a customer is ready to buy, not before.
- **Cashfree processes every payment.** Customers pay on Cashfree’s secure payment experience, and every payment shows up in your Cashfree dashboard.
- **You can step in any time.** Chats your agent can’t handle are handed over to you, and you can still collect payment through Cashfree.
- **You can switch it off.** Disconnect Cashfree from Connected apps whenever you want.


##


**Questions worth asking about your WhatsApp sales**


If you sell on WhatsApp, these are good places to start:


- How many enquiries reach you after business hours, and how many get a reply before the customer moves on?
- How long does a customer wait between “I’ll take it” and a way to pay?
- How much time do you spend sharing QR codes and matching payment screenshots?
- When a chat goes quiet after “How much?”, do you know why?


The answers usually point to the same place. The problem isn’t getting customers to talk to you. It’s turning those conversations into payments, fast.


##


**Getting started**


###


**Already on Cashfree? Connect in a few taps**


You’ll need Meta Business Agent set up on your WhatsApp Business app, and an active Cashfree account. Then:


1. Open the WhatsApp Business app and go to **Tools** .
2. Tap **Meta Business Agent** .
3. Under **Ways to control your AI** , tap **Connected apps** .
4. Find **Cashfree** in the list of partner apps and tap it.
5. Log in to your Cashfree account and review the permissions.
6. Tap **Allow access** .


That’s it. Cashfree now shows as connected, and your agent can send payment requests as soon as customers are ready to buy. No coding or API setup needed.


To check it’s working, tap **Test your AI** on the Meta Business Agent screen and ask to buy something, the way a customer would.


Need help connecting, or don’t see Meta Business Agent in your Tools yet? Tell us, and our team will help you get set up.


[Register your interest →](https://forms.gle/K9Qhh4NMi1teC4XdA)


###


**New to Cashfree?**


You’ll need an active Cashfree account to collect payments through your agent. Sign up in a few minutes, complete your account activation, then connect it to your agent using the steps above.


[Sign up for Cashfree →](https://merchant.cashfree.com/merchants/signup)


###


**Get the most out of your agent**


Your agent can only sell what it knows. A few things make a big difference:


- **Add your products and prices.** Link your WhatsApp catalogue, or upload your product details.
- **Answer the common questions.** Add your FAQs, delivery times and return policy.
- **Keep it current.** Update prices and stock when they change.
- **Test it.** Ask it what your customers usually ask, and fill in anything it gets wrong.
- **Read the chats it hands over.** They show you what information is still missing.


---


Your customers already decide to buy in the chat. Now, from the first question to the collected payment, your agent handles it all, at any hour, while you get on with running your business.


[Register your interest →](https://forms.gle/K9Qhh4NMi1teC4XdA)


##


**FAQs**


**Who can use Meta Business Agent?** Meta is rolling it out to eligible WhatsApp Business accounts. Open **Tools** in your WhatsApp Business app to see if it’s available to you.


**How do my customers pay?** They tap Pay now on the Cashfree payment request in the chat and pay with their preferred method, such as UPI, cards, netbanking or wallets. They come back to the same chat once they’ve paid.


**Where can I see my payments?** In your Cashfree dashboard, like any other Cashfree payment.


**What does it cost?** Payments through your agent are charged at your standard Cashfree Payment Links rates. Meta Business Agent’s own pricing is set by Meta and shown in the app.


**What if my agent can’t answer a customer?** It hands the chat over to you. You can reply yourself and still collect payment through Cashfree.


**Can I disconnect Cashfree later?** Yes. Go to **Connected apps** , tap **Cashfree** and tap **Disconnect** .
